verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 product page offers some first-party support for this story. It says local AI models can take your files for "smarter, more personalized results," and that Project G-Assist is an AI assistant that helps tune and optimize your system. Both are companion software that runs on the GPU rather than an in-product data-insight feature, and each gets only a thin marketing mention. missing for 10: documented workflow for generating insights or suggestions from user data, detail on what data sources and outputs are supported, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Add your files for smarter, more personalized results.
NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.
